preserved: Every non-whitespace body text node in source; all nonempty Markdown/HTML text with original line numbers. Code identifiers/numbers/prose/headings/table-cell text are retained; inline Markdown links retained.
removed: HTML structure tags and their attributes; empty whitespace; empty Markdown table separator/header rows; only structural comments. URL/anchor attributes require separate mechanical checks. Source non-body UI/header/footer are outside document body and separately inspected.
limitations: Derived views aid full semantic reading; extraction or machine checks alone do not count as AI review. No range marked read until all view text is actually read. Code/URL/id and original diff/structural verification remain required.
